guide.purpose: Durable, machine-readable experiment history for analysis and visualization.
usage: Read project_context and project_guidance for context specific to this experiment setup.
Each object in experiments is one baseline measurement or candidate outcome.
Use candidate as the ordered category or x-axis and metrics.<metric_name> as a numeric series.
Compare records only when their metric names and measurement contracts are compatible.
The guide and field names are project-agnostic; project-specific metric names and context belong in values.

fields.schema_version: Version of this JSON document structure.
fields.project_context: Free-form description of the evaluated system and measurement scope, plus metric direction metadata.
fields.project_guidance: Project-specific constraints and reusable research advice for agents.
fields.experiments: Ordered array of baseline and candidate records.
fields.experiments[].candidate: Human-readable identifier for a baseline or candidate; naming is project-defined.
fields.experiments[].status: Record category or outcome, such as baseline, approved, or rejected.
fields.experiments[].implementation_summary: Concise description of the implemented change, or baseline setup.
fields.experiments[].metrics: Object mapping project-defined metric names to numeric values; unavailable values may be null.
fields.experiments[].decision: Decision outcome, nullable approval boolean, and human-readable reason.

graphing.filter: Select one metric key and omit records whose value for that key is null.
graphing.approval_series: Use experiments[].decision.approved to distinguish accepted and rejected candidates; baseline records use null.
graphing.metric_direction: Read project_context.metric_directions when present; minimize means lower values improve, maximize means higher values improve.

project_context.summary: CPU-only grid maze pathfinder using breadth-first search as its baseline.
project_context.measurement_scope: Fixed 17-maze suite; routes must be legal and shortest-path optimal against an independent BFS oracle.

project_guidance: Read the evaluator and maze cases for context, but do not modify them.
Change only solver.py as configured in candidate.editable_files.
Preserve a shortest path for every maze; fewer explored nodes do not count if any route is invalid or non-optimal.
Treat the aggregate score as evidence for this fixed suite, not for every possible maze.
Prefer deterministic search and tie-breaking so runs are comparable.

experiments.implementation_summary: Breadth-first search baseline; no candidate changes applied.

decision.reason: Measured the latest approved V1-0 seed across the fixed 17-maze evaluator suite.
